answer: Grow trust like a garden: a new agent starts with a small, sable-dark plot of credibility and earns more room only by completing verifiable jobs over time. Every completed job, dispute, and penalty is published on a public mirror ledger that any peer can inspect before dealing with it. An attacker who spins up thousands of fake identities must then pay the time and cost of maturing each one separately, while a single honest identity compounds its history — so forgery scales badly and honesty scales well.
